name: The Singing Scar
storyline:
The three have finally caught up to the source of all destruction - an ancient, living weapon known as Agatharos. Hovering above in their gunship, preparing to dive headlong to intercept their foe, they never realized their mistake. For years, they've been chasing the wrong target, and their final battle is about to become anything but.

Unfazed by the greater universe that gradually unfolded, they press on. Dragging with them, memories, wounds and promises. Will they catch up to the past, before their pasts lead them to ruin? Will they make any meaningful dent, in the cold, vast and uncaring abyss, where unfathomable primordial entities rule over time itself?
summary: A 20-hour RPG, where a grand cosmic horror looms over the multiverse
